defs: def doc_text($p): .assets[$p]; def schema($n): (.manifest.plugins[] | select(.name == $n) | .input_schema); def plug($n): (.manifest.plugins[] | select(.name == $n)); def row($coll; $key; $id): .config[$coll][] | select(.[$key] == $id);

jq.name: the pack ships exactly the charts and charts_save plugins, both rust
charts reads and charts_save writes: the declared bind access is the only difference in authority
jq.expr: plug("charts").bind_dir.access == "read" and plug("charts_save").bind_dir.access == "read_write" and plug("charts").bind_dir.input_field == "path" and plug("charts_save").bind_dir.input_field == "path" and plug("charts").bind_dir.original_field == "path_original" and plug("charts").manifold == null and plug("charts_save").manifold == null

jq.name: limits stay inside the host ceilings and the output limit is the host's 4 MiB
the schema is closed, requires chart and lists every chart type the tool documents
jq.expr: schema("charts") as $s | $s.additionalProperties == false and $s.required == ["chart"] and ($s.properties.chart.enum | sort) == ["area", "bar", "box", "bubble", "combo", "donut", "heatmap", "histogram", "horizontal_bar", "line", "pie", "scatter", "stacked_area", "stacked_bar"]

jq.name: charts_save has the charts fields and save, nothing else
jq.expr: (schema("charts_save").properties | keys) == ((schema("charts").properties | keys) + ["save"] | sort) and ((schema("charts").properties | has("save")) | not)

jq.name: every field the schema names is explained in the tool instructions
jq.expr: doc_text("plugins/charts/TOOL.md") as $t | [schema("charts").properties | keys[] | select(. != "path_original") | . as $k | select(($t | contains("`" + $k + "`")) | not)] == []

jq.name: numeric limits in the schema match the ones the tool states
jq.expr: schema("charts").properties as $p | $p.width.minimum == 200 and $p.width.maximum == 4096 and $p.height.minimum == 150 and $p.height.maximum == 4096 and $p.scale.minimum == 0.5 and $p.scale.maximum == 4 and $p.y.maxItems == 24

jq.name: the Chart maker's Tools document grants exactly the two plugins
the behavior uses the declared inference slot and a prompt that names both tools
jq.expr: row("agent_behaviors"; "behavior_id"; "chart-maker").inference_profile_id == "gents:inference-slot:chart_maker" and (.manifest.inference_slots | map(.name)) == ["chart_maker"] and (doc_text("agent_behaviors/chart_maker/system_prompt.md") | contains("`charts`") and contains("`charts_save`"))

jq.name: the two graph nodes split on save and write one ChartResult each
jq.expr: row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; "chart-render").source_collection == "ChartRequest" and row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; "chart-save").source_collection == "ChartRequest" and (row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; "chart-render").filter | contains("save")) and (row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; "chart-save").filter | contains("save")) and (row("callbacks"; "callback_id"; "chart-render").handler.plugin == "gents/charts") and (row("callbacks"; "callback_id"; "chart-save").handler.plugin == "gents/charts_save") and all(.config.callbacks[]; .handler.outputs | length == 1 and .[0].collection == "ChartResult" and .[0].required == true)

jq.name: only the save node's binding passes save, and every passed field is a ChartRequest field
jq.expr: doc_text("schemas/chart_request.graphql") as $g | (row("callback_bindings"; "binding_id"; "chart-render").input_fields | index("save")) == null and (row("callback_bindings"; "binding_id"; "chart-save").input_fields | index("save")) != null and all(.config.callback_bindings[].input_fields[]; . as $f | $g | contains("  " + $f + ":"))

jq.name: the request fields of the schema are exactly the tool fields plus run_id
jq.expr: doc_text("schemas/chart_request.graphql") as $g | ([$g | scan("\\n  ([a-z_0-9]+):") | .[0]] | sort) == ((["run_id"] + (schema("charts_save").properties | keys)) | sort)

jq.name: the result schema carries the documented fields
the README documents all three call paths with a command or call each
jq.expr: doc_text("README.md") as $r | ($r | contains("## Use it as a model tool")) and ($r | contains("## Use it as a graph node")) and ($r | contains("gents plugin run charts ")) and ($r | contains("create_ChartRequest"))

jq.name: the font licence travels with the pack: names, source and both checksums
jq.expr: doc_text("notice.md") as $n | ($n | contains("SIL Open Font License")) and ($n | contains("76d04c18ea243f426b7de1f3ad208e927008f961dc5945e5aad352d0dfde8ee8")) and ($n | contains("788abee4c806d660e8aee46689dd8540cd4bb98da03dcc9d171ce3efd99a9173")) and ($n | contains("liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5"))

jq.name: no document of the pack contains an em dash or an en dash
